notes.title: Steamdeck compatibility update + minor fixes
notes.notes:
This new patch attempts to enhance Steam deck compatibility for the game. The game should now start with gamepad controls enabled for Steam deck users, initialize at 1280x720 resolution, and UI scaling has been fixed for a few problematic screens when using Steam deck resolutions. 

Other minor fixes include a few spelling errors and a permanent buff in the Butlery not activating properly. 


As always, if you enjoy the game I would really appreciate you thinking about leaving a review so others can find it too! 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: 6/26/2025- Minor fixes and changes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where some save files could not be deleted
Added filters to the save screen to view all saves or instead just manual and quicksaves
Minor changes relating to enemy confusion
Fixed bug where some monsters in the prologue would not animate correctly

notes.title: January '25 update: New monsters, new potions, new traits, who dis
notes.notes:
This update was mainly started to address two issues- the Etherealize spell was buggy when resting, so it has now been fixed, and I was asked to add support for ultra widescreen and super ultra widescreen. While the UI does not change, both of those aspect ratios are now supported for the game camera. 

Also my kid drew some monsters and I made them ːsteamhappyː

Full (mostly) changes below:


 Fixed bug with Etherealize and resting

 Added support for ultrawide and super ultrawide resolutions

 Heal/Group Heal now additionally heal for a small percentage of the recipient's max HP

 Using abilities outside of combat no longer switches to the next character (useful for spamming heal)

 Added Toothbrush Fairy monster
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/620f7cda31862c6492ba34a8b44a416ce769d1bc.png

 Added Cake Grump monster
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/81691136278f763682f964fbbd8b9ba61fe53e55.png

 Added Hoodlumure monster
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/a9ea0e6e3bb8de33bc2992b120ca4fc412caa1e6.png

 Changed how some monster traits and buffs work

 Changed how the enemy detail box works- right clicking/right stick press now toggles the box and allows the user to hover over each trait or buff. Moving the mouse outside of the box or clicking will remove the box (On gamepad pressing the right face button or right stick again will close the box)

 Added Dualstriker trait: Character strikes twice each attack

 Added Freshener trait: Character's attacks have a chance to remove poison/disease from target

 Added Adorable trait: Character who kills a monster with Adorable gains the Depression debuff

 Added Angry trait: +2% attack damage per stack

 Added Juggernaut trait: Character gains 5 attack buffs (+10% att each) each turn spent moving without attacking, loses all buffs after attacking

 Added Ranged Mass Attack trait: Character can randomly choose to do a ranged attack to all available targets, with a longer recovery time

 Rebalanced many enemy traits (i.e., added many traits to enemies)

 Added Calm ability
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/b08b801e311999cd9ed5dbb92663588ef630a211.png

 Added Chosen One ability
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/849fd97718ec70f1d8c3a957d4480b123fc5c3e5.png

 Added Revive potions, and small chance to find potions in enemy loot drops

 Rebalanced potion levels, added new potions

 Added randomized (and non-randomized) potions to chests throughout the world



Enjoy!

notes.title: 10/16/2024 Update: Minor fixes and additions
notes.notes:
Additions:

- The spell purchase screen will now tell you which skill(s) govern the selected spell
- The disguise buff (found on some items and by using the Smokescreen ability) will now trigger a silly mustache/glasses icon on the affected character portrait, like so:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914988/896ea28feea66fc260fd3a2f37f2156642e3cf1a.png

- The Jester's Crack Wise ability can now sometimes triggers a disguise buff (if nobody likes the jester's joke).
- A new set of glasses to help show off the Disguise buff and icon (level 35 artifact)

Fixes: 

- The damage taken when using MP while above the max was bugged, this has now been fixed
- The crosshair icon on ability icons was sometimes not showing up properly in the abilities menu, this has been fixed

notes.title: 10/15/2024 Update
notes.notes:
This update should finally fix the bug with temporary stat/skill changes not wearing off properly. Please let me know if it somehow persists, but I did identify the issue which caused it, which relied on a very particular set of circumstances making it a very rare occurrence.

Other minor fixes-

- Several minor typos
- Fixed an issue with conversation/quest data not being saved properly 
- Fixed an issue where trap triggers on the third dungeon floor did not fire properly

notes.title: Minor update 10/12/24
notes.notes: This update fixes the Reset Stats function at the cheat vendor (.devfix.resetstats is the code for it), and also fixes a minor issue with the Unleash ability where sometimes the monster buddy wouldn't load correctly.

notes.title: 10/11/2024 Patch- Another go at fixing stat/skill issues
notes.notes:
This update shouldn't change much, despite the size. It mainly addresses the still rare issue of stat/skill/resistance bonuses or penalties not wearing off correctly, and also hopefully fixes the dev fix function at the cheat vendor in town (usable by typing in ".devfix.resetstats" into the cheat window).

Additionally, this update adds much more detail to the combat log when an effect wears off. You'll notice this in combat of course but it can also be seen outside of combat by opening the log in the notes menu. The purpose of this is to help me narrow down why exactly this stat/skill/resistance bug happens, if it happens again, so if anybody does experience an issue where those values are much, much lower or higher than they should be (even after considering equipment bonuses) please let me know in as much detail as you can what may have happened.

I apologize that this issue seems to be persisting, and thank you for playing!

notes.title: Minor update- Map save fix
notes.notes:
This update should finally fix the issue with maps sometimes not loading the fully explored area when loading from file.

Important: saves made before this patch will likely still have missing map reveal progress upon loading, at least for some of the levels. But any saves made after should work correctly when loaded from file. I apologize for the issue.

notes.title: Added update to game over screen
notes.notes:
The game over screen had fallen through the cracks in the UI update. It has now been updated as well to match the rest of the UI.

Hopefully you won't see it much!

notes.title: DR Boss bug fix
notes.notes:
This patch addresses an issue where the state of the doors after the DR boss would sometimes load improperly when loading a savegame. 

Also addresses an issue where there was a delay in activation of the post-Core boss state upon loading, which could lead to the player being stuck in level geometry.

Additional changes:

- This update should allow interaction highlights to occur on loading
- This update should also allow for additional stability with party/individual effects wearing off properly
- Fixed the "flee to" location in the lab level

Thank you as always for your patience!


EDIT:

Just uploaded another minor patch which fixes one stairway in the tower level which was mistakenly flagged as single time use.

notes.title: Minor stability update
notes.notes:
An issue has been brought to my attention seemingly revolving around the steam overlay being enabled. I'm having trouble completely replicating it, but this update should hopefully help prevent it from occuring.

Still, I would recommend avoiding opening the steam overlay often, and saving before doing so. If something does get corrupted exiting the game and loading that save will fix it. 

Part of this effort sees the "select previous character" function mapped to ctrl+tab now, rather than shift+tab as it was before. 

Thanks again for playing!

notes.title: Minor prologue update
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where Jenny can still be killed/knocked out via MP damage. 

Rebalanced the prologue party a bit more- mainly a lot more defensive buffs.

notes.title: Big changes to Albright Outpost!
notes.notes:
New locations have been discovered in Albright Outpost! In anticipation of the upcoming final content update, the Development Gnomes have prepared new areas of the outdoors to explore. Including a mysterious abandoned house with a tightly locked door. What secrets could it hold? And a new NPC to have a short conversation with. 

In addition to all of this, this update fixes a few more minor bugs and enhances the UI:

- Fixed exploit with character creator not resetting pool points when changing class
- Fixed UI scaling issues in conversations
- Fixed equipment stat comparison
- Added the ability to buy the selected spell in the magic shop with the space button
- Fixed issue that could occur with levers not having their states saved correctly upon saving game
- Several other minor UI tweaks


Hope you enjoy the new update, and look forward to the big content update coming soon!

notes.title: Update: Fixed aspect ratio
notes.notes:
This update corrects the issues with aspect ratio being unfixed for some menu elements. Every element should now function correctly for all resolutions, including the Steam Deck's 1200x800 resolution.

Also fixed minor error with text input functions

notes.title: Reverting to previous update due to equipment bug
notes.notes: I'll update it shortly, I apologize.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes: The previous update introduced a few minor issues with the Ultimate HERO and Dragon Form abilities, which have now been fixed. I apologize for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Major Update- New Prologue/tutorial and HUD
notes.notes:
This is not THE big one, but nevertheless a big one. The big new features here:

- Prologue. Accessible from the main menu when you start a new game, you can now play through the short prologue to get a feel for various gameplay elements before being prompted to create your party. This should be extremely helpful for newcomers who tend to get stuck on character creation.

- New HUD. Inspired by several requests for more HUD features, the main-game HUD now has two new elements

              - the upper menu icon bar. This tells you which keyboard keys take you to which menu sections (oh yeah, that's also new), as well as introduces the "Flee" key, only usable in combat of course. 

              - the right-hand Buff Bar, which now conveniently shows you which party buffs are currently active. A handy way to realize what you may be missing. 

              - Also, the ability in the Options menu to change HUD style if you don't like this new one. Either to Buff-Bar only or classic/light. HUD opacity can still be changed in the video options. 



Some other minor changes/fixes:

- Added quickload function. F9 (the default key) will now load the most recent quicksave instantly.
- Changed how Prepare Weapons/Armor works: Prepare Weapons now comes with a base additional damage bonus on top of the multiplier bonus. As a result use in early levels should see better results before it evens out at higher levels. 
           - Fixed error with the Prepare Weapons/Armor icons staying on the party buffs page- these buffs are now removed after every combat encounter as explained in the description
-Fixed minor issue with some chests not saving state
-Fixed missing gold cost for Solar Fusion (sorry)
-Fixed recently introduced bug that prevents characters from learning spells from scrolls

notes.title: Minor additional update
notes.notes:
I wasn't sure I'd get to this today, but I managed to. 

This update does two things- 

- Increases availability of healing/mana potions at the general store. Higher character levels mean the store will have stronger potions available.

- Adds indicators to the character icons in the pause menu which will let you know if the character is ready to level up, and if the character has enough unspent skill points to raise a skill level.

notes.title: Minor update 4/13/2024 (my birthday)
notes.notes:
Happy birthday me, woo!

Anyway, this one is a minor update:

- Fixed issue with the Transfigure Equipment spell. It should now work properly both in and out of battle
- Fixed various minor UI issues
- Fixed issues with XP values getting too long for the screen- they have now been condensed after the value exceeds 10,000 or 10,000,000 to have a k or a M after the value.
- Minor typo corrections

notes.title: 4/11/2024 Update
notes.notes:
Inflation has hit Mican! Learning a new skill now costs 2000 gold, this was done to prevent players from being overwhelmed with skill choices early on. Other changes:

- Put a lower limit on recovery rate: recovery rate can no longer go below 10. Hover over the displayed rate in the character screen to see the true recovery rate value
- Added a "recovery time" indicator to the progress bar on each character's portrait. This tells you how much time (in ambiguous time units, not seconds) you still need to recover for a new action
- Changed the recovery time for defending from 50 to 30, this lets you recover more quickly if you simply defend. 
- Added a red skull indicator to the top of the MP bar if your MP exceeds the max. If you see the red skull there, using magic will damage you heavily!

- Fixed minor issue with lava field ability

notes.title: 4/8/2024 Update: Merchant and Burglary skill improvements
notes.notes:
This update primarily focuses on the Merchant and Burglary skills, which previously had inaccurate descriptions.

-Burglary Master: you now have a chance to steal an item from an enemy on a standard attack
-Burglary Legend: at the legend rank all enemies will drop extra gold (2x the normal amount) and may drop a second item, depending on your luck

-Merchant: Fixed the price calculation on buying and selling. The max discount is now 75%, and the maximum selling price increase is 175%. 
-Merchant Abilities: Added two brand new abilities for the Merchant skill- Toss Gold and Make It Rain. Both abilities cause enemies to become confused with a high reliability
-Merchant Grandmaster: all shops will have more basic items and special items to sell at a time
-Merchant Legend: you now have a 50% chance of receiving a free item when buying any item, the free item being of up to 2x the quality of the one you bought

Other changes:

-Fixed minor UI issues
-Changed quickspell menu to not pause the game music
-Changed enemies to stop wandering when player movement is paused

notes.title: 4/6/2024 minor update
notes.notes:
-Added indicators in the overview screen and character screen detailing how much XP is needed until the next level

-Fixed a bug where the mob resetting lion would activate any time you reenter town after using it

notes.title: 4/5/2024 Patch
notes.notes: -Fixed save bug where a "create new save" button would not appear in the full save menu if a save hadn't been previously created (through autosave/quicksave)

notes.title: 4/4/2024 Polish update and minor fixes
notes.notes:
Added a few new functions to help make for a smoother experience.

-Added a "move back" function for enemies who get too close (i.e. in the camera view)
-Added a few more safeguards to prevent enemy turns from overlapping
-Changed a few UI elements to be more uniform and look a bit nicer
-Changed the starting tutorial to be clearer and more effective
-Added an option to see the tutorial again when interacting with Jeppel

-Fixed issues with gamepad use in options/video menu
-Fixed a few late-game achievement bugs
-Fixed issue with party wipe-out from stoning preventing recovery from stoning
-Fixed issue with town portal after being the game

As always, thanks for playing and please share any other issues you may come across!

notes.title: April Fool's update
notes.notes:
Jesters aren't always the best class to have in your party... but for a short time each year they are blessed by the heavens, and make a valuable contribution to any party!

(From now on, for the first week of April any year all Jesters will have boosted attack, defense, and Crack Wise will be much more effective)

notes.title: 3/30/2024 Update: Fixed gold overflow
notes.notes:
- Fixed gold overflow bug: previously after exceeding the engine limit for the gold integer (over 2 billion) the gold would then become negative. This will no longer occur.

- Added a gold dev fix to the cheat vendor- if something does cause the gold to go negative input the code ".DEVFIX.GOLD" to the cheat vendor in town to switch it back to a positive value.

- Fixed minor issues in a late game boss encounter.

- Added a few new artifacts and cheat codes

notes.title: 3/29/2024 Update
notes.notes:
-Fixed various minor bugs
    - Fixed skill point dialogue after leveling up
    - Disabled autosave from occurring in the main menu when starting a new game
    - Fixed minor UI issues

- Added a keyboard configuration readout, which lists each input key in the game, not just the ones that can be changed

- Fixed keyboard remapping feature to save configuration when saving a game. This will likely cause your keyboard configuration to revert to default after downloading this update, but all subsequent saves should contain the correct input configuration.

notes.title: Minor polish patch
notes.notes: Several monsters' attack timings were slightly off so they've been fixed for a smoother user experience.

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes:
-Magic Missile previously froze the game if no enemies were in view, this has now been fixed

-Kraken Puppae during Draken fight could sometimes spawn incorrectly and remain within the level bounds, this has now been fixed

notes.title: Keymapping fix patch corrected
notes.notes: The update should now be functional.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix (plus bonus monster)
notes.notes:
This update fixes a couple of minor issues with the key remapping menu. Namely, it fees up the left and right arrow keys to be used for moving left and right, and fixes an issue with mapping "backwards" movement to the S key.


Additionally, there should be a new monster type called a Poultrygeist in the game. It can spawn randomly at any spawn point that contains its monster level. Bawk bawk!
